label: Passengers, Freight and Commercial Flights
note:
TAM07 has replaced TAM05 from January 2020. TAM07 should be used from January 2020 as classifications have been changed. Note: EU28 excl Ireland excludes UK from January 2020. Data is subject to revision. Transit passengers are counted twice (i.e. both as arriving and departing passengers) See TAM03 for data prior to 2013.
